05 / FIELD NOTES

A small
blog.

Short thoughts from building, reading, moving, and paying closer attention.

001
BUILDING

Useful over impressive.

+

The work I keep coming back to starts with a messy, specific problem. Good software makes the hard parts quieter. The point is rarely the cleverness; it is whether someone can use the thing without needing to understand how much went into it.

002
MOVEMENT

Motion makes room.

+

A run, a lift, a match, or a long trail changes the scale of a problem. Movement gives ideas somewhere to settle and makes it easier to come back with a clearer head.

003
INPUTS

Keep a wide aperture.

+

Old records, modern history, philosophy, sports, unfamiliar cities, and a good conversation all feed the same instinct: look at the system from another angle before deciding you understand it.

OPEN INBOX

Found something good?
